name: Make a web request
description: Fetch data from a web API or endpoint on your network or the internet.
setup_guide: Change the URL constant to the endpoint you want to poll. This template returns `status_code` and `body` on every run. To see it on the dashboard: open the module, go to the Variables section, add a new variable named `body` (Type: string), then attach a Text Display visualization with JSON Path `body`.
